notes.A: Hanging cuts and lanterns frame the counter, but the nearest carcass blocks half the room.
notes.B: Lanterns, stock shelves, and counter goods are legible, but cropped meat crowds the foreground.
notes.C: The counter leads past hanging cuts and shelves, but its near end is cropped.
notes.D: Stock shelves and aisles dominate, with the butcher’s counter squeezed against the left edge.
notes.E: Counter and shelving read clearly, though blank wall and ceiling take up much of it.
notes.F: Open floor and stacked stock establish depth, but a crate dominates the butcher’s area.
notes.G: Meat and countertop goods show the trade, but a foreground carcass hides the layout.
notes.H: Counter, hanging cuts, and surrounding stock share the frame, though a foreground shelf intrudes.

market_hall.best: H shows the whole butcher’s counter, hanging meat, stock shelves, and aisles in one readable view.
market_hall.lacks: The counter lacks visual prominence. In the room’s even gloom, the hanging cuts and countertop goods blend into the surrounding stock.
market_hall.fix: Concentrate warm light over the butcher’s counter so the hanging cuts and work surface stand out from the darker aisles.

blind_name.name: Butcher’s market stall
blind_name.why: Skinned carcasses hang over a wooden counter, with stocked shelves and crates behind it.
blind_name.odd: The small red objects on the counter are hard to identify.
